newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH KPW PLANS TO REVIEW NFI FUNDS IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: POLISH KPW PLANS TO REVIEW NFI FUNDS IN MARCH.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) expects to review this month for public trading shares in 15 National Investment Funds (NFI) in the country's mass privatisation scheme, the KPW spokeswoman said on Thursday.
"We plan to review at a single session this month all 15 NFI prospectuses," Beata Stelmach told a news conference.
She said that the commission was now working on 32 issue prospectuses including 15 submitted by NFIs.
About 95 percent of 28 million adult Poles bought participation certificates in the scheme, which entitle them to receive 15 shares, one in each NFI fund.
The funds' Warsaw bourse listing is expected no sooner than in mid-year. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
